title: symbolic_regression_signalling: code for "Symbolic regression enables coarse-grained model discovery of intracellular signalling dynamics"
description:
Pipeline for discovering coarse-grained models of intracellular signalling dynamics by symbolic regression: synthetic enzyme-kinetics benchmarks, data degradation experiments, and symbolic-regression and sparse neural ODE models of ERK phosphorylation across cancer-relevant overexpression contexts.

Hyperparameter grids and per-context metrics reported in the paper are under results/published/. The experimental measurements analysed are not redistributed here; they are the mass cytometry data of Lun et al., available from Mendeley Data at https://doi.org/10.17632/3kh7ypz232.1 (CC BY 4.0).
